notes.title: Ver.1.5.4: Notification of update completion
notes.content:
The following bugs have been fixed.

[olist]
[*] There is a case that you can get the achievement even if you do not meet the conditions in Mission 14.
[*] There is a case that the specific effect remains after mission 15.
[*] Minor corrections to character and gun illustrations.
[*] Correction of Chinese translation mistakes.
[*] Some enemy may not be drawn if it is at the edge of the screen.
[/olist]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35059199/22d9fc0cdfe72481a1edf57ec2af41761bd555b4.png[/img]

The major update of Heroine of the Sniper has been completed with Ver.1.5.4.

Thank you for playing this game!
I am especially honored that many people challenge to collect achievements and to play speedrun.
I'm very sorry that I couldn't respond to the many requests to want to play more missions.
I got help from many people shown in the credit.

Finally, I will introduce the images used in the game and the original musics.
